name: interview-skills
description: Skills for time-boxed live coding sessions: interview-mode orchestrates minimal output, expectation-driven slices, parallel workstreams and failure-mode review.

plugins.name: interview-mode
plugins.description: Start a time-boxed live coding session (interview, take-home walkthrough, timed demo).

plugins.name: minimal
plugins.description: Minimal-output mode for time-boxed, high-pressure sessions (live coding interviews, pairing, demos).

plugins.name: edd
plugins.description: Expectation-Driven Development, a lightweight TDD for AI-built code.

plugins.name: plan-split
plugins.description: Split a feature or brief into parallel workstreams that several agents (Claude subagents or Codex) can build at once without blocking each other.

plugins.name: failure-review
plugins.description: Fast review of a diff for the ways it breaks in production: re-runs, partial failure and crashes, duplicates, bad input, flaky dependencies, concurrency and locking, ordering, resource limits, secrets/PII.

plugins.name: coding-practices
plugins.description: Concept checklists for writing and reviewing code: Python, databases/data pipelines, and agentic/LLM workflows (orchestrators, tool calls, structured output, API calls).
